descByPlatform.flux: A stunningly crafted soft modern aesthetic digital art portrait of a young Indian woman with a warm natural smile and long flowing black hair, maintaining strict face preservation. The composition places her in a slightly right-of-center mid-shot framing with a beautifully constructed pastel background: abstract flat paper-cut flower shapes layered in soft powder blue, warm cream, and muted canary yellow tones create a dimensional botanical backdrop. Large ornate gold metallic flowers with metallic foil sheen are layered around the subject — one large statement bloom to the left, smaller accent flowers to the right — alongside small delicate white blossoms. The paper-cut collage design aesthetic: slightly elevated shadow-casting depth on each paper element, minimalist paper grain texture visible on background planes. Bold oversized uppercase "QUEEN" text in a modern geometric sans-serif font in warm beige becomes a design element. Overlapping it at a slight angle, the same word "queen" appears again in a smaller loose casual red handwritten brush-script, creating a playful typographic counterpoint. Lighting: soft overhead natural warmth, no harsh shadows, cheerful and dreamy ambiance. Ultra-detailed professional finish, glowing natural skin with smooth luminous texture, 8K rendering, 4:5 aspect ratio.
